title: Cs-doping suppresses hysteresis in MAPbI3 solar cells
body:
Adding 5 mol% CsI to MAPbI3 precursor reduced J–V hysteresis from 18% to 4%.
[Step] Precursor mixing
  [Input] PbI2, MAI, CsI, [Tool] DMF/DMSO solvent (4:1)
[Step] Spin coating
  [Parameter] 4000 rpm 30 s, anti-solvent drop at 10 s, [Output] 480 nm absorber
[Step] Device IV
  [Tool] Keithley 2400 + AM1.5G, [Output] PCE 19.1%, HI = 0.04
The hysteresis index dropped likely because Cs+ stabilises the perovskite lattice and reduces ion migration along grain boundaries.
